title: Malicious code in voltswannts (PyPI)
description: The PyPI package 'voltswannts' version 0.1.0 is identified as malicious software that falsely advertises itself as an 'audio-analysis profiles' loader. Its actual purpose is to download and execute a remote malicious script, continuing a known coin-mining campaign. This package poses a direct threat by executing unauthorized remote code.
aiSummary: The 'voltswannts' package on PyPI, specifically version 0.1.0, is part of a malicious campaign that masquerades as an audio-analysis tool but is designed to execute remote code. The package does not embed the malicious URL directly but downloads and runs a remote script, indicating a continuation of a previous coin-mining campaign named 2026-10-voxeval. This behavior classifies it as malware with clear intent to compromise systems.
aiImpact: Installation of this package can lead to execution of unauthorized remote code on the affected system, potentially enabling further malicious activities such as coin mining or data theft. The package's deceptive nature increases the risk of inadvertent installation by users expecting legitimate functionality.
